## Summary

Describe the change and the scientific or engineering reason for it.

## Evidence and provenance

Explain any effect on evidence classification, dataset licensing, normalization, or reproducibility.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend formatting, lint, typing, and tests pass
- [ ] Frontend lint, tests, and production build pass when applicable
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests
- [ ] Documentation and data-license metadata are updated
- [ ] No generated datasets, credentials, or proprietary records are included
